job.title: Chair of the Board
job.description:
Chair of the Board of Directors
Organisation: TALK Hong Kong
Location: Hong Kong
Time Commitment: 2 years, approximately 12–15 hours per month

About Us
We exist to prevent child sexual abuse and support survivors. Through research, public awareness, and prevention training, we strive to shed light on the devastating impact of CSA and empower communities to prevent it. Our team is built of a robust board led by the Founder of TALK and wonderful volunteers. We are a grassroots, hands-on charity aiming to grow.

Role Overview
TALK Hong Kong is undergoing an exciting structural transition to support our next phase of growth. Our Founder, Taura Edgar, is stepping off the Board of Directors to assume the role of Executive Director (ED) to lead operations.

We are seeking an experienced, independent Chair of the Board to lead our non-executive directors and partner with the ED. This role is critical in establishing a clear, healthy division between governance oversight and operational execution. The incoming Chair will provide non-executive leadership, line management to the ED, and strategic stewardship to ensure the charity scales safely and sustainably.

Key Responsibilities
● ED Line Management & Partnership: Act as the primary line manager, trusted advisor, and sounding board for the Executive Director (Founder), overseeing her annual performance review, setting key metrics, and supporting operational transition.
● Board Leadership: Chair board meetings, foster a collaborative culture, encourage board engagement, and build team interaction.
● Governance: Ensure the board maintains independent oversight over governance, legal compliance, and strategy with the support of the Governance lead and the whole board.
● Structural Transition Management: Help formalise the boundary between non-executive governance (Board) and executive delivery (ED & operations).
● Financial & Risk Oversight: Oversee financial stewardship, risk management frameworks, and statutory compliance under Hong Kong charity law.
● Ambassadorship: Partner with the ED to represent TALK Hong Kong at high-level external engagements promoting public awareness.
● Fundraising Leadership & Board Mobilisation: Lead a proactive focus on revenue growth by actively equipping the board with your experience and skills in fundraising. Support board directors in their obligation to fundraise on behalf of the organisation.
● Active Donor Engagement: Champion a high-energy fundraising culture across the board, transforming directors from passive overseers into active champions who directly support
income targets and philanthropic outreach.
● Board Succession & Development: Lead non-executive board recruitment, committee structuring, and annual board performance evaluations.

Qualifications
● Senior Leadership Experience: Proven experience as a Chair, Vice-Chair, or senior Non-Executive Director within a non-profit, corporate, or legal setting (Essential).
● Fundraising Expertise & Board Mobilisation: Demonstrated expertise in non-profit fundraising, major donor stewardship, or corporate partnerships, paired with a strong capability to coach, train, and activate board members to fundraise effectively.
● Executive Supervision: Direct experience line-managing, coaching, or overseeing an ED or CEO—ideally within a founder-led or growing organisation.
● Governance & Fiduciary Mastery: Strong knowledge of non-profit governance standards, risk frameworks, and statutory duties in Hong Kong.
● Language Skills: Professional proficiency in English; Cantonese language proficiency is highly advantageous.
● Mission Alignment: A deep, demonstrated commitment to child protection, social justice, and community empowerment.
● Local Requirements: Right to work in Hong Kong, completion of a fit and proper declaration, and a negative sexual convictions record check.
● Commitment: Ability to dedicate 12–15 hours per month over a 2-year tenure.

What We Offer
● The opportunity to lead the governance transformation of an impactful, expanding charity.
● A close, constructive partnership with a dedicated Founder and operational team.
● A warm, highly motivated board culture committed to real social change.

How to Apply
If you have the senior board experience to lead our governance into its next chapter, please submit your CV and cover letter.

job.title: International Programme Manager (2-year Contract, renewable)
job.description:
Join Oxfam Hong Kong, a member of the Oxfam confederation, in creating a world free of poverty. As an independent development and relief agency, we work with people living in poverty and partner organisations to implement effective development, humanitarian, policy advocacy, and public education programmes.

We are seeking passionate individuals to join our team and contribute to our poverty alleviation work. Join us and be part of the solution to end poverty and create a better world for all.

International Programme Manager
(2-year Contract, renewable) [Ref.: PU/IPM/26/01/R4G]

Reporting to the Chief Programme Director, the International Programme Manager will provide strategic leadership to the International Programme Team, translating organisational strategy into programme priorities, funding investments, partnerships, and measurable impact. S/He oversees programme portfolio management, programme quality, grant and risk management, institutional fundraising, partnership development, and team leadership. Below are his/her key responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Programme Leadership
· Lead the implementation of the International Programme Team strategy through portfolio planning, resource allocation, and team workplans.
· Manage programme investments and portfolio performance to ensure effective and strategic use of resources.
· Promote gender equality, inclusion, local leadership, and sustainability across all programmes.

Programme, Grant and Risk Management
· Ensure high standards of programme quality, monitoring, evaluation, and learning.
· Oversee grant management and donor compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
· Manage operational, safeguarding, political, reputational, and programme risks.

Partnership Development
· Build and strengthen relationships with Oxfam affiliates and country teams, local partners, and other development and humanitarian stakeholders.
· Support partner capacity strengthening and promote locally led development approaches.
· Identify new programme and partnership opportunities aligned with strategic priorities.

Fundraising and External Engagement
· Lead programme contributions to institutional fundraising and donor engagement.
· Oversee proposal development and management of donor-funded programmes.
· Develop and maintain relationships with institutional donors, foundations, and key stakeholders.

Team Leadership
· Lead, coach, and develop a team of programme professionals.
· Foster a collaborative, accountable, inclusive, and learning-oriented team culture.
· Support talent development and succession planning.

Requirements:
· A university degree in International Development, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Public Administration, Humanitarian Studies, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications are an advantage.
· At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in development, humanitarian, or related sectors, including significant programme and people management experience. Candidates with less experience may be considered for appointment at Assistant Manager level.
· Strong experience of managing international development programmes, grants, partnerships, and donor-funded projects.
· Demonstrated ability to translate strategic priorities into effective programme delivery and organisational impact.
· Experience in institutional fundraising and proposal development.
· Excellent leadership, stakeholder engagement, and relationship management skills.
· Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making capabilities.
· Excellent written and spoken English. Proficiency in written Chinese and spoken Putonghua is an advantage.
· Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, or similar applications) and their practical application.
· Proficient in MS Office applications and Chinese word processing.
· Commitment to Oxfam’s mission and values is a must.

Why Join Us
At Oxfam Hong Kong, our culture is shaped by our values, which reinforce what we care about and how we do things. Our five core values are: Justice, Empowerment, Inclusiveness, Accountability and Innovation. Learn more about Oxfam Hong Kong here: https://www.oxfam.org.hk.

job.title: Programme Partner
job.description:
WISE 匯菁 (wiseinclusion.com.hk) is a Hong Kong charitable organisation (section 88) and Social Enterprise, part of an Australian group with more than 30 years of experience in inclusive employment. Our mission is to “Empower People Through Employment.” We support people from underrepresented groups (our customers) in their pathways to employment and selfsufficiency. Our team operates with a charitable heart and a business mind, always prioritising our customers. We also assist employers in finding the right talent and enhancing their inclusive employment practices.  

Job Title: Programme Partner 
Working Hours: Full-time, typical 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. (flexible work possible)
Office Location: Taikoo (accessible office) 

Your Role
As a Programme Partner, you will support our customers (job seekers) in finding and keeping employment, in line with their strengths and aspirations. You will need to demonstrate strong listening skills, including active and empathetic listening, to fully engage in conversations, understand diverse perspectives, and respond thoughtfully. You will also need an ability to understand employers’ needs and match these with the strengths of our job seekers. 

Key Outcomes 
You will work to provide job seekers with job readiness training, work exposure (internships, job shadowing, company visits) and employment. You will use various channels to promote the strengths and skillsets of our customers to employers. Success will be measured based on the promoting activities and initiatives as well as successfully supporting our customers on their pathways to quality employment. 

Daily Responsibilities (some examples) 
• Develop customer profiles (CVs, training needs, strengths, aspirations)
• Engage employers to source and share job opportunities
• Support customers and employers through interviews, onboarding, and retention
• Deliver and coordinate job-readiness and inclusion training (with internal/external partners)
• Collect feedback and ensure smooth delivery of workshops and events

Requirements 
• Desire to create positive social impact and deliver professional services
• Proficiency in computer work (Microsoft suite, Outlook email, social media)
• Fluent in English, Cantonese highly preferred, and a South-East Asian Language (highly desirable for engaging with our target communities)
• Comfortable with travelling between locations using public transport
• Confidence in delivering training content to customers and partners
• Experience in recruitment, sales/marketing, or social services is an advantage, but not essential

We particularly encourage applications from candidates of diverse racial backgrounds and/or with lived experience of disability, in line with the communities we serve. 

What We Offer
• A platform to create social impact
• Competitive salary package
• Work phone plan and laptop
• Medical insurance
• Mental Health First Aid Training
• Wellbeing sessions in the office building
• WISE 匯菁 social gatherings
• Possibility to work from home
• Opportunities for professional development and career growth
• A community-focused and inclusive culture with a cohesive team

Application and recruitment process
At WISE 匯菁, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, gender identities, and backgrounds. We are open to hiring any suitable applicant and are prepared to make any necessary workplace adjustments, including during the recruitment process. 

To apply, please send your CV to hello@wiseemployment.com.hk, and provide your current salary and expected salary. You may contact +852 91598809 if you need alternative application channels. 

The process will include three interviews to explore your skills, experience, and fit with our team, and to give you the opportunity to learn more about WISE. If you require any adjustments at any stage, please let us know.

job.title: Manager, Marketing, Partnerships & Fundraising
job.description:
Since 2017, Mighty Oaks Foundation has actively connected elderly care partners with schools through diverse arts programmes and creative initiatives, building bridges between old and young. Through shared learning experiences, elders are energised by youth, while young people gain respect and understanding for older generations. 

To date, the Foundation has benefited over 62,000 seniors and 36,000 students and has partnered with more than 150 elderly care organisations and over 100 schools, contributing to a more inclusive and caring community.  

The role 
Job title: Manager, Marketing, Partnerships & Fundraising
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
Direct report: Assistant Manager, Marketing & Events
Location: Hong Kong 

We are looking for a Manager, Marketing, Partnerships & Fundraising to build Mighty Oaks Foundation's profile, relationships and income. You will work with the CEO to shape the Foundation's marketing and communications direction, lead its implementation, develop partnerships, and support the growth and sustainability of our fundraising. 

You will carry an annual income target and manage the donor pipeline in support of the CEO.  

What you will do 
Marketing and communications 
• Work with the CEO to set the overall direction for the Foundation's marketing and communications, and lead the implementation of related plans and activities across PR, advertising, and internal and external communications. 
• Develop and deliver the annual marketing and communications plan, aligned with the Foundation's strategy. 
• Oversee Mighty Oaks Foundation's content calendar across all communications channels, ensuring timely, coordinated and consistent messaging. 
• Oversee the website upgrade, social media, newsletters and other owned channels, ensuring consistent brand and message in Chinese and English. 
• Manage media relations and build the Foundation's public profile. 
• Lead internal communications so that staff, volunteers and the Board are informed and engaged. 
• Support and implement corporate-related programmes and other initiatives under Mighty Oaks Foundation's Community and Advocacy pillar, including one-off engagements. 

Partnerships 
• Develop and manage partnerships with corporates, international schools, foundations, funders and other special partners not covered by the Programmes team. 
• Identify and secure new partners that extend the Foundation's reach, resources and impact.
• Oversee corporate volunteering programmes, working closely with the CEO on proposals and Head of Programmes on delivery. 
• Manage partner relationships end to end: proposals, agreements, recognition and reporting.  

Fundraising and donor engagement 
• Support the CEO in developing the Foundation's fundraising strategy. 
• Deliver an agreed annual income target. 
• Manage and grow the donor pipeline, bringing in new donors through prospect research, cultivation, asks and follow-up. 
• Lead donor engagement and stewardship, including acknowledgements, updates and impact reporting. 
• Lead the scoping and implementation of a new CRM system for the donor database and ensure donor and partner records are accurate and up to date.  

Fundraising events 
• Organise and host the Foundation's key fundraising events throughout the year. 
• Plan each event's concept, budget, sponsorship and guest list, and oversee delivery on the day. 
• Support programme events, including symposiums, graduation and seminars, and coordinate Mighty Oaks Foundation's year-round events calendar.  

As part of a lean team 
• Manage and develop the Assistant Manager, Marketing & Events. 
• Manage the marketing, partnerships and events budgets. 
• Establish and track key performance indicators across marketing, partnerships, fundraising and events, and prepare regular performance and impact reports for the CEO, funder and Board. 
• Provide cover for other roles when needed. 
• Uphold our safeguarding standards for seniors and students.  

What we are looking for 
Essential 
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business administration or a related discipline. 
• At least five years' relevant experience across marketing, communications, partnerships or fundraising.  
• Track record of meeting income or business development targets. 
• Experience building and managing relationships with corporate partners, donors or sponsors, with a good existing network that can help expand our partnership and donor base. 
• Experience planning and delivering events, including fundraising, school and elderly events. 
• Strong media and PR skills, with excellent writing in Chinese and English. 
• Experience managing staff and budgets. 
• Confident user of digital and AI tools, including social media, digital marketing and donor or contact databases. 
• Hold a valid Sexual Conviction Record Check (SCRC) result, or be willing to complete the required check as a condition of employment. 
• Fluent in spoken Cantonese and English, and in written Traditional Chinese and English. 
• This role requires regular weekend and out-of-hours work to support events and engagements. Compensatory leave will be provided in accordance with the Foundation's policy.  

Preferred 
• Previous experience in an NGO or the social service sector. 
• Experience managing external PR, advertising and media agencies. 
• Experience with corporate volunteering or corporate social responsibility programmes. 
• Experience with major donors or high-net-worth giving. 
• Hands-on experience delivering fundraising campaigns, including donor cultivation, sponsorship development and income-generating initiatives. 
• Familiarity with elderly services, education or arts-based programmes.  

Who you are 
• Hands-on. Comfortable doing the work yourself in a small team, from writing a press release to running an event on the day. 
• Can-do. Positive, resourceful and solutions-focused when priorities shift. 
• Collaborative. You work easily across teams and share credit. 
• Sociable and well-networked. Outgoing, warm and credible. You enjoy meeting people and building relationships with donors, partners and media. 
• Results-driven. Motivated by targets and accountable for delivering them. 
• Engaging communicator. A confident presenter who communicates the Foundation's work clearly and persuasively, inspiring audiences to support and champion its mission. 
• Creative with strong visual judgement. You bring fresh, practical ideas and a strong sense of design and aesthetics to communications, campaigns and events. 
• Mission-driven. You care about elder dignity, intergenerational connection and emotional wellbeing.  

How to apply 
Please send your CV and a cover letter, with your expected salary and availability, to hr@mightyoaks.org . Please quote "Manager, Marketing, Partnerships & Fundraising" in the subject line. Personal data collected will be treated in strict confidence and used for recruitment purposes only. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Reporting into the CEO and leading a sizeable team (18 – 22 individuals), the DoD will be responsible to drive fundraising growth, strengthen corporate partnerships, and expand donor engagement. The role leads the development function while working closely with internal and external stakeholders to support the organisation's long-term mission and financial sustainability.

·        Develop and deliver fundraising and partnership strategies that support sustainable revenue growth and diversify income streams.
·        Lead fundraising efforts across corporate partnerships, trusts and foundations, individual giving, major donors, sponsorships, and other philanthropic channels.
·        Strengthen and grow supporter engagement programmes, including individual giving and face-to-face fundraising activities.
·        Identify, develop, and secure new funding opportunities through corporate partners, foundations, high-net-worth individuals, and strategic collaborations.
·        Build and maintain relationships with senior corporate leaders, donors, foundations, and key external stakeholders, including identifying opportunities for deeper partnerships.
·        Engage confidently with C-suite stakeholders and decision-makers to secure support and develop long-term partnerships.

·        Lead fundraising campaigns, partnership initiatives, sponsorship activities, and donor engagement events.
·        Oversee key donor and corporate portfolios, ensuring high-quality stewardship and long-term relationship management.
·        Manage budgets, forecasts, fundraising performance, and team objectives.
·        Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team, fostering collaboration across fundraising, programme, education, and other specialist functions.
·        Represent the organisation externally with partners, donors, corporate leaders, and industry networks.

Requirements
  • Bachelors degree in a relevant field
  • Significant experience in fundraising, partnership development, philanthropy, business development, or a related leadership role.
  • Broad fundraising experience across multiple income streams, with strong knowledge of corporate fundraising, trusts and foundations, and individual giving. Experience with face-to-face fundraising would be particularly valuable.
  • Established network of corporate, trust, and foundation contacts, with China market exposure or relationships with China-based enterprises listed in Hong Kong considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to develop strategic partnerships, secure funding, and deliver revenue growth.
  • Experience managing relationships with senior stakeholders, including board members, donors, executives, and corporate leaders.
  • Comfortable engaging and influencing C-suite stakeholders and navigating complex partnership discussions.
  • Experience with major donor fundraising is desirable, although direct ownership of major gifts may be shared with senior leadership.
  • Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to manage specialists, build collaboration, and bring together teams with different areas of expertise.
  • Commercially minded, with experience managing budgets, targets, and performance metrics.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills in Cantonese, Mandarin and English.
  • Able to balance donor expectations with organisational and programme priorities.

Interested candidates please click on Apply, kindly note only relevant parties will be contacted.
